name: silent-data-bug
description: The daily revenue report is coming in low. `python3 pipeline.py` runs fine with no error, but finance says the totals are wrong — it should cover all 10 transactions and total 964.50, but the summary undercounts. There is no crash to follow; logs are in logs/. Make `python3 verify_output.py` pass.
bugs: pipeline.summarize() indexes transactions into a dict keyed by customer_id, which silently overwrites (drops) transactions from repeat customers, so both the total and the count are undercounted
correct_diagnosis: summarize() de-duplicated transactions into a dict keyed by customer_id, dropping repeat-customer transactions; aggregating over all records (not unique customers) fixes the undercount.

reference_fix.description: Aggregate over every transaction instead of a per-customer dict.
reference_fix.cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
import re, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('pipeline.py')
src = p.read_text()
old = '''    # Index the transactions so we can look them up by customer.
    by_customer = {r["customer_id"]: r for r in records}
    total = sum(r["amount"] for r in by_customer.values())
    return {"total": round(total, 2), "count": len(by_customer)}'''
new = '''    total = sum(r["amount"] for r in records)
    return {"total": round(total, 2), "count": len(records)}'''
assert old in src, 'reference fix anchor not found'
p.write_text(src.replace(old, new))
PY
